title: Record sanitized import refresh events
decision: SG-0007 import refresh should append a sanitized import event to workspaces/epp-full/audit/ledger.jsonl and print a matching console summary. The event may include counts, validation statuses, preserved-state status, seeded-sidecar counts, source kind labels, source commit/branch provenance, and error summaries, but must not include raw source paths, development-only source filenames, source-files paths, original source_path values, browse targets, or download targets.
context: Import refresh mutates the app-facing workspace and now preserves app-owned audit/workbook/runtime state. The user agreed that this mutation should be traceable in the app's audit trail, while keeping the source-cleanup guardrails intact.
rationale: A sanitized ledger event gives future humans and local agents a durable explanation of what changed during import without reintroducing development-only source details into app-owned state.
alternatives_considered: Only print import results to the console
Write a detailed developer report containing raw source paths
Defer all import traceability until the audit UI exists
consequences: SG-0007 should preserve the existing audit ledger and append one sanitized import event per successful refresh
The console summary and audit event should use the same explicit count labels for documents, provenance-only sources, retained regulatory sources, preserved state, and seeded sidecars
The source-leak check should include audit import events so ledger entries cannot retain disallowed source markers
Detailed developer-only diagnostics may remain console-only or in failing command output, but should not be retained in the app-facing workspace ledger
